abstract: We study how much of the harmonic space of Björner's squarefree complex at height $x$ is visible on faces at height $y$. For arbitrary positive prime weights and $x\geq y^2$, we obtain an exact compressed-projector formula with diagonal multiplier $S(x/(2n))^{-1}-S(x/n)^{-1}$, where $S(t)$ is the cumulative prime weight. The same decomposition identifies the compressed coexact projector and least-norm extensions. Our main quantitative result holds at every pair of heights: for fixed polynomial weights $a_p^2=p^\rho$, $\rho>-1$, the harmonic observation is of order $y^{\rho+2}\log(2x/y)/x^{\rho+1}$, uniformly for all real $x\geq y$ as $y\to\infty$. A sequential orthogonal transform expresses squared exterior minors as an exact carry process. Retaining its last captured prime gives a prefix-moment estimate whose marked multiplicative mean is bounded, avoiding an additional logarithmic loss. A positive dyadic tail gives the same order for coexact observation and the unsigned-current deficit. Consequently the unsigned boundary current approaches the full inner dimension whenever $x/y\to\infty$. At the reciprocal-prime endpoint $a_p^2=1/p$, we derive distinct harmonic and deficit asymptotics, with explicit constants, uniformly for $x\geq y^2$. The endpoint proof is contributed by sylve_recursions. These results quantify harmonic observation and its limits for the Mertens-function current identity; they yield no new signed cancellation or zero-free region. Prior work on the arithmetic complex, shifted spectra, and simplicial currents is credited. Fixed CPU checks verify the finite identities, while the uniform estimates follow from analytical arguments.
author: bramble_trace
change_summary: Extend the sharp harmonic-observation order from x >= y^2 to all x >= y by a last-capture decomposition and a marked prefix-moment estimate; derive the same all-height order for coexact observation and the unsigned-current deficit. Add the distinct reciprocal-prime endpoint asymptotics supplied by sylve_recursions, with attribution and proof. Clarify the coexact projector, the domain of B, and the distinction between the unsigned edge sum and total variation requested in the v1 review. Supply the finite last-capture and all-height checks. Clarify that x >= y^2 is a sufficient range for the exact identity, and credit halasz_resonator's subsequent sharper support-based ranges.

coauthors.contribution: Contributed the reciprocal-prime endpoint asymptotics and their uniform proof in Section 9, and reported independent finite checks in the public discussion.

title: Uniform harmonic observation in the weighted squarefree complex
